हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/HXkswM
show.description: Supreme Billionaire is a dramatic love story that blends romance, betrayal, and family legacy. It follows Vikrant, a hidden heir to the powerful Singhaniya empire, who falls deeply in love with Tanishka, a simple but strong-willed woman. Their journey is tested by years of struggle, including Vikrant’s long coma, Tanishka’s sacrifices to save him, and the schemes of rivals like Adwait, who constantly tries to break them apart.
